description: This file defines types, utility functions, and interfaces for handling suggestion results in a React-based autocomplete component, including grouping, ungrouped suggestions, loading states, and result normalization.

methods.name: isItemLoaded
methods.description: Returns true if the item is an actual item and not a loading indicator.

methods.name: emptyResults
methods.description: Returns an empty SuggestionResults object with default values.

methods.name: hasResults
methods.description: Checks if there are any suggestion results.

methods.name: hasLoadedResults
methods.description: Checks if there are any loaded suggestion items, including loading indicators.

methods.name: countResults
methods.description: Counts the total number of suggestion items and loading indicators.

methods.name: getItemForTerm
methods.description: Retrieves the item corresponding to a specific term from the suggestion results.

methods.name: flattenTerms
methods.description: Returns a flat array of all suggestion terms.

methods.name: flattenItems
methods.description: Returns a flat array of all suggestion items.

methods.name: hasSuggestionWithComponent
methods.description: Checks if any suggestion is rendered with a specific React component.

methods.name: normalizeResultsFromProvider
methods.description: Converts provider results into a standardized SuggestionResults format with an array of components.

methods.name: trimResults
methods.description: Limits the number of suggestions to a maximum, removing excess and empty groups if grouped.
